claim.quote: ArDM-1t is the first operating ton-scale liquid argon detector for direct search of Dark Matter particles.

key_value.note: Liquid argon filled into the target vessel.
key_value.quote: recent filling of the target vessel with almost 2 ton of liquid argon

name: Status of ArDM-1t: First observations from operation with a full ton-scale liquid argon target
notes: Preliminary report of May 2015; no journal publication was found.

summary.plain: Report on the filling of ArDM with almost two tonnes of liquid argon at Canfranc and on the first single-phase data taking (Run I).
summary.technical: Commissioning achievements and preliminary observations of single-phase Run I with a full ton-scale liquid argon target, including a first indication of the background discrimination power of LAr detectors at the ton scale, and an outlook for completing the detector with a drift field and SiPM light readout.

title: Status of ArDM-1t: First observations from operation with a full ton-scale liquid argon target
why_it_matters: The collaboration describes it as the first operating ton-scale liquid argon detector for direct dark matter searches.
